description: Test jsonb_each_text in FROM position, which expands into two text columns: key and value
name: jsonb_each_text_from
query_sql:
-- @name GetDocEntryText
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, kv.key, kv.value FROM documents, jsonb_each_text(data) AS kv
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE documents (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, data JSONB NOT NULL, metadata JSONB);
